scripts.build: turbo run build && bun run perf:check
scripts.test:unit: turbo run test && bun run test:coverage
scripts.perf:browser: playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "home scene meets runtime performance gates" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "work scene meets runtime performance gates" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "room designer loads compressed interior props" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "web layout does not reserve space for the desktop status bar" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "desktop status bar and overlays stay inside the scene viewport" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "HQ keeps perspective backgrounds fixed while the camera moves" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "HQ plays only the active locomotion animation" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "switching from a reference character to Custom"
scripts.test:e2e: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium && bunx turbo run build --filter=@agent-hq/web^... && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/web/e2e/workspace-guest.spec.ts && bun run perf:browser
scripts.perf:gate: bun run build && bun run perf:browser && bun run perf:check:runtime
